Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the mandate.

ApplicableChannel.name: Applicable Channel
ApplicableChannel.definition: Channel for which the operation mandate is valid. If ApplicableChannel equals Fax, this means that a bank operation instruction sent by fax will be processed according to the mandates exchanged in this message.

RequiredSignatureNumber.name: Required Signature Number
RequiredSignatureNumber.definition: Number of required and necessary signatures by the mandate.

SignatureOrderIndicator.name: Signature Order Indicator
SignatureOrderIndicator.definition: Indicator whether a certain order of signatures has to be respected or not.

BankOperation.name: Bank Operation
BankOperation.definition: Bank operation allowed by a mandate.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Specifies the date when the mandate becomes valid.

EndDate.name: End Date
EndDate.definition: Specifies the date when the mandate stops to be valid.
